subject: french

moments.title: France enters WWI
moments.body: France mobilises against Germany. Trench warfare follows along the Western Front.
moments.takeaway: World War I left scars across French villages.

moments.title: Battle of Verdun
moments.body: Verdun lasts ten months with over 700,000 casualties.
moments.takeaway: Verdun became a French national symbol of endurance.

moments.title: Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
moments.body: An unknown soldier is interred under the Arc de Triomphe; an eternal flame is lit in 1923.
moments.takeaway: WWI created new rituals of national mourning.

now.title: WWI memory today
now.body: Centenary commemorations (2014-2018) renewed interest. Trench archaeology continues in northern France.
now.open_questions: How will WWI be remembered as the last survivors' children pass?

reflection: France's countryside still preserves WWI's geography.
